label: Desserts and baked goods
description: Named desserts, sweet pastries, confections, frozen treats, and savory or plain breads from world cuisines.
notes: Desserts, sweet baked goods, and named bread forms belong here; food.dish holds savory meals and filled savory dishes, while food.drink holds beverages. Values are recognizable names that follow “a serving of,” with visual glosses describing the finished food. Kind chips overlap when useful, such as fried pastries, and region tags describe culinary associations rather than exclusive origins. Tiers reflect expected dessert and bakery imagery, not cultural importance.
